title: Home fieldwork written guide: safety, what to record, how to draw
subject: Geography
unit: Spring 2: Map skills and fieldwork (Tribal Tales)
source: Written for geography/y3 lesson 14 (Home fieldwork written guide: safety, what to record, how to draw (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 14: Fieldwork at home: my sketch map. Read it all first; an adult knows what you are doing.

practical.aim: To map and record the features of your street or garden
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Tidy up and wash your hands
method: Go out with an adult; stay on the pavement or in the garden
Walk a short route and note human features (houses, shops) and physical features (trees, grass)
Note which way you faced using the compass
Draw a sketch map with a key when you get home

questions.a: Finding out by looking in a real place
options: Finding out by looking in a real place

questions.q: Big question: can you map a place without another map?
questions.a: Yes, with careful looking, a key and a north arrow, though it may not be exact
